1.english_reference: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖ וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑י

traditions.VUL: et inváluit contra Israel .
traditions.KJV: and strengthened himself against Israel .

2.english_reference: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah

traditions.KJV: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah ,

2.english_reference: and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֤ן נְצִיבִים֙ בְּ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ בְ עָרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέστησεν ἡγουμένους ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν Ἰούδα καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν Ἐφράιμ
traditions.VUL: Præsidiáque dispósuit in terra Iuda , et in civitátibus Ephraim ,
traditions.KJV: and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim ,

2.english_reference: which Asa his father had taken

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד אָסָ֥א אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: ἃς προκατελάβετο Ἀσὰ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: quas céperat Asa pater eius .
traditions.KJV: which Asa his father had taken .

3.english_reference: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט

traditions.VUL: Et fuit Dóminus cum Iósaphat ,
traditions.KJV: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat ,

3.english_reference: because he walked in the first ways of his father David

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י הָלַ֗ךְ בְּ דַרְכֵ֞י דָּוִ֤יד אָבִי ו֙ הָ רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδοῖς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ταῖς πρώταις ·
traditions.VUL: quia ambulávit in viis David patris sui primis :
traditions.KJV: because he walked in the first ways of his father David ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א דָרַ֖שׁ לַ בְּעָלִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐξεζήτησεν τὰ εἴδωλα ,
traditions.VUL: et non sperávit in Báalim ,
traditions.KJV: and sought not unto Baalim ;

4.english_reference: But sought to the [ LORD ] God of his father

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י לֵֽ אלֹהֵ֤י אָבִי ו֙ דָּרָ֔שׁ

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ מִצְוֺתָ֖י ו הָלָ֑ךְ

traditions.KJV: and walked in his commandments ,

4.english_reference: and not after the doings of Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֖א כְּ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

traditions.VUL: et non iuxta peccáta Israel .
traditions.KJV: and not after the doings of Israel .

5.english_reference: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨כֶן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת הַ מַּמְלָכָה֙ בְּ יָד֔ וֹ

traditions.KJV: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand ;

5.english_reference: and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנ֧וּ כָל יְהוּדָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לִ יהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט
traditions.LXX: ἔδωκεν πᾶς Ἰουδὰ δῶρα τῷ Ἰωσαφάτ ,
traditions.VUL: et dedit omnis Iuda múnera Iósaphat :
traditions.KJV: and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents ;

traditions.VUL: factǽque sunt ei infinítæ divítiæ , et multa glória .
traditions.KJV: and he had riches and honour in abundance .

6.english_reference: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּגְבַּ֥הּ לִבּ֖ וֹ בְּ דַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑψώθη καρδία αὐτοῦ ἐν ὁδῷ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque sumpsísset cor eius audáciam propter vias Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD :

6.english_reference: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah

traditions.WLC: וְ ע֗וֹד הֵסִ֛יר אֶת הַ בָּמ֥וֹת וְ אֶת הָ אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים מִ יהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆρεν τὰ ὑψηλὰ καὶ τὰ ἄλση ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: étiam excélsa et lucos de Iuda ábstulit .
traditions.KJV: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah .

7.english_reference: to teach in the cities of Judah

traditions.KJV: to teach in the cities of Judah .

8.english_reference: and with them Elishama and Jehoram , priests

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ בְּ כָל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽ יְלַמְּד֖וּ בָּ עָֽם

traditions.KJV: and went about throughout all the cities of Judah , and taught the people .

10.english_reference: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that [ were ] round about Judah

traditions.KJV: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that [ were ] round about Judah ,

10.english_reference: so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat

traditions.KJV: Also [ some ] of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents , and tribute silver ;

11.english_reference: and the Arabians brought him flocks , seven thousand and seven hundred rams , and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats .

traditions.WLC: גַּ֣ם הָֽ עַרְבִיאִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֥ים ל וֹ֙ צֹ֕אן אֵילִ֔ים שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וּ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּ תְיָשִׁ֕ים שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְ גָדֵ֖ל עַד לְ מָ֑עְלָ ה

12.english_reference: and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֧בֶן בִּֽ יהוּדָ֛ה בִּירָנִיּ֖וֹת וְ עָרֵ֥י מִסְכְּנֽוֹת

traditions.KJV: and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .

traditions.WLC: וּ מְלָאכָ֥ה רַבָּ֛ה הָ֥יָה ל֖ וֹ בְּ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה

13.english_reference: and the men of war , mighty men of valour , [ were ] in Jerusalem .
